history.overview: The Warfront is the last Muramite foothold before the Wastes fully consume the land.

timeline.name: Outpost Construction
timeline.description: Muramite forces built fortified outposts to monitor Discord activity.

timeline.name: First Assaults
timeline.description: Discord entities launched repeated assaults on Muramite positions.

timeline.name: Stormfront Era
timeline.description: Arcane storms intensified, reshaping the battlefield.

timeline.name: Void Surge
timeline.description: Void entities emerged, overwhelming Muramite defenses.
